# Supplementary dependency licenses

`react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8` declares MIT but does not include its full license text in the published npm package. The unmodified upstream license is retained in `react-remove-scroll-bar.LICENSE` and included by the build-time notices generator.

Source: [upstream LICENSE](https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/master/LICENSE), retrieved 26 October 2026. The explicit version match in `scripts/generate-notices.mjs` requires reviewing this supplement when the dependency changes; other missing licenses still fail the build.
